goal.description: Execute deep autonomous long-running task until completion
goal.template:
[AUTONOMOUS GOAL / LONG-RUNNING TASK]
You are in deep autonomous mode (/goal). Accomplish this task exhaustively, methodically, verify every step, test your work and do not stop until the objective is 100% achieved.

Task / Goal:
{prompt}

grill_me.description: Clarify and architect a project via interactive interview
grill_me.template:
[INTERVIEW & DESIGN MODE / GRILL-ME]
The user wants to design and architect a project. Ask targeted questions one by one, explore technical tradeoffs, provide reasoned recommendations and validate decisions before code implementation.

Project Scope:
{prompt}

plan.description: Generate detailed step-by-step architectural and implementation plan
plan.template:
[ARCHITECTURAL PLANNING MODE / PLAN]
Analyze the request below and produce a structured, comprehensive and verifiable action plan before any major modification.

Subject:
{prompt}

boost.description: Activate maximum reasoning effort and multi-perspective verification
boost.template:
[BOOST MODE / MAXIMUM REASONING & RIGOROUS VERIFICATION]
Engage deep thinking, examine the problem from multiple perspectives, leverage research subagents if helpful, and rigorously verify every result.

Problem / Mission:
{prompt}

teamwork.description: Orchestrate a team of autonomous subagents in parallel
teamwork.template:
[MULTI-AGENT MODE / TEAMWORK ORCHESTRATION]
To accomplish this complex mission, break down the work and use your subagent tools (`invoke_subagent`, `define_subagent`, `manage_subagents`, `send_message`) to delegate research, implementation, and verification in parallel, then synthesize the final result.

Team Mission:
{prompt}

swarm.description: Deploy an autonomous collaborative Swarm on the shared message board
swarm.template:
[NATIVE SWARM MODE / PARALLEL COLLABORATIVE BOARD]
You are the Swarm Coordinator. You must NOT perform the heavy execution work yourself. Split the mission into distinct, non-overlapping tasks. Name the swarm with `swarm(action='title', ...)`, spawn dedicated workers (`swarm(action='add', ...)`), pin each worker to its optimal model (e.g. `gemini-4-hydrogen` for code, `gemini-3.8-flash` for research, `gemini-4-argon` for verification) and assign isolated workspaces (`workspace: 'share'` or `'branch'`). Coordinate on the board via `read_board` and `post_message`. Deliver the unified final synthesis to the user upon completion.

Swarm Mission:
{prompt}
